engineHint.gog: The sign-in stays in gog's keyring on this server; Helena reaches it through the broker. No mailbox in the inbox.

clientDialog.fileHint: Google Cloud → APIs & Services → Credentials → OAuth client ID (Desktop app) → Download JSON.
clientDialog.label: Name

signIn.title: Connect Google account
signIn.emailHint: Needed for gog; for Helena Google preselects the account.
signIn.pasteStep: After signing in, the browser ends on a page that does not load (127.0.0.1). Copy the full address of that page and paste it here.

signIn.removeFromGog: Remove the sign-in from gog afterwards

servicesDialog.title: Services of {email}
servicesDialog.hint: A service switched off is not available to any agent.
servicesDialog.gogNoMail: An account kept in gog has no mailbox in Helena. Move it to Helena for the inbox.

mailbox.fetchDaysHint: The first import fetches only this period; older imported copies are removed daily. The mail on the server stays.
mailbox.resetMessage: Every imported copy (messages, attachments, stored files) is deleted and the mailbox imports again within its fetch window. The mail on the server stays.
mailbox.googleHint: Signs in with its Google account (no app password). Servers and login come from the account.
mailbox.gmailHint: For Gmail, connect the Google account under Access & connections → Google instead: no app password needed.

grants.title: Access to {name}
grants.hint: Grant it to single agents or to every agent of a project, for all services or one, to read only or to write as well. Sending, sharing and deleting still wait for your approval.

clone.title: Clone with {name}
clone.hint: The runner of an agent of the project clones the repository with this key into the area's folder of the workspace. The workspace repository then ignores it.

mcp.kindHint: An MCP server that signs in with OAuth. Helena keeps the token; the MCP server library sends it as the Authorization header.
mcp.title: Connect an MCP server
mcp.label: Name
mcp.hint: Helena finds the server's sign-in, registers itself and asks you to sign in. Then pick this connection as the Authorization header of the server under MCP servers.
